description: Encode a Cardano testnet payment-only (enterprise) address. The address bytes are a single header byte (0x60 = network 0 / type 0x6 = enterprise) followed by a 28-byte payment-key hash. The bech32 encoding uses the HRP `addr_test` and the standard bech32 polymod (BIP-0173). Catches SDKs that misuse bech32m, drop the HRP, or mishandle the 8→5-bit conversion.
